choices: The interface must have at least one method
The interface must have exactly one abstract method — a compile error if violated
All methods in the interface must be default
The interface can only be implemented by lambda expressions
explanation: @FunctionalInterface is a marker that causes the compiler to verify the interface has exactly one SAM. If you accidentally add a second abstract method, the compiler reports an error. Without the annotation, the interface is still functional — it just isn't protected against accidental expansion.
